title: Bulbasaur to Ivysaur to Venusaur evolution
narration: Bulbasaur is getting ready for something big.
Its body starts to glow. Bulbasaur is evolving!
Bulbasaur evolved into Ivysaur, and the power keeps growing!
And now Ivysaur becomes Venusaur! Who is your favourite Grass-type Pokemon? Comment below!
